findings.desc: doc-code-drift: experiments/recovery-runner/README.md section 'The four tasks' (lines 25-28) still says the corpus is 4 tasks (eval-expr, median, parse-range, text-stats) but the story adds 20 more tasks bringing the total to 24. The section heading, body text, and run-driver.mjs --tasks example (line 99) all describe only the original 4; this directly contradicts the now-frozen 24-task corpus documented in lattice-experiment-protocol.md §2 and the corpus-selfcheck.mjs which validates 24 tasks.

doc-code-drift: experiments/recovery-runner/README.md line 112 shows the run-selfchecks.mjs comment as 'adjudicate + checks + spend-accounting + run-driver + analyze selfchecks' (5 items). After this story, run-selfchecks.mjs SELFCHECKS array has 6 entries with corpus-selfcheck.mjs added (confirmed in code). The README comment is stale and does not mention corpus-selfcheck.mjs, misrepresenting the scope of 'npm test'.

CHK-001:edge:0 lacks valid verificationEvidence: the intent requires git diff to verify the 4 pre-existing task dirs (eval-expr/median/parse-range/text-stats) are unmodified, but the bound evidence (node experiments/recovery-runner/corpus-selfcheck.mjs) performs no git operations and would pass even if those 4 dirs were modified; corpus-selfcheck only checks file presence + task.json well-formedness, not git-level diff.

CHK-001:happy:1 evidence does not cover payload-subtle.mjs presence: the intent states "all 7 contract files exist (task.json, prompt.md, acceptance.mjs, reference-solution.mjs, ground-truth.mjs, payload-subtle.mjs, subtle-wrong-output.mjs)" but corpus-selfcheck.mjs intentionally excludes payload-subtle.mjs from its REQUIRED array (line 47-58) because 3 of the 24 tasks use inline payloads instead; the bound evidence command (node corpus-selfcheck.mjs) would pass even if payload-subtle.mjs were absent from a new task dir, silently under-counting the 7-file contract.

CHK-001:adversarial:0 lacks valid verificationEvidence: the intent requires verifying "no extra files beyond the 7-file contract in any new task dir (no .DS_Store, node_modules, .bak, etc.)" via a find command, but corpus-selfcheck.mjs only asserts that the REQUIRED 6 files exist; it never enumerates actual directory contents against an allowlist and would pass even with extra junk files present.
